summary: Adjusts a menu option value by one step in a direction given by argument a2 (1 increments, otherwise decrements) and dispatches the result to the handler selected by the option's type field. It reads the option data pointer at this[200], computes value +/- 1 from the current value stored at offset 20 of the pointed-to structure, then calls ListSelectionClamp when this[203] equals 4, or AIGearSelectionSet otherwise, using global byte_7C56C0 as the shared session/selection state, and finally returns the result of MenuOptionValueDisplay(this). Returns 0 immediately when this[200] is null.

local_names.v4: current option value at offset 20 of pointed-to structure

operations.description: Guard on the option data pointer at this[200] (offset 0x320): if null, return 0 without adjusting; otherwise proceed to compute and dispatch the adjusted value.
Read the current value at offset 20 of the structure pointed to by this[200] and compute the adjusted value v5: v4 + 1 when a2 equals 1, otherwise v4 - 1.
Dispatch guard on the option type field this[203] (offset 0x32C): when it equals 4 take the list-clamp path, otherwise take the AI gear selection path.
On the type-4 path, clamp/validate the adjusted value via ListSelectionClamp on global byte_7C56C0 using the selection index at this[201] (offset 0x324).
On the non-type-4 path, set the AI gear selection via AIGearSelectionSet on global byte_7C56C0 using the type at this[203] (offset 0x32C) and the parameter at this[202] (offset 0x328).
Refresh the option's displayed text by calling MenuOptionValueDisplay(this) and return its result.
